objective: Remove persistent empty 100dp Wall and 97dp Connect Notes rails above profile avatars in the Android UI; make note height follow visible text while preserving five-line Notes, avatar alignment and AdMob functionality.
productionBaselineEvidence: Existing main 63ccd4b58ff02ff3c1535a1e05d3097fa8323c61 and published staging head 8b152c571a923e85b8812a55120d2e3a72c2301a; no native, backend, production or AdMob modifications proposed.
chosenApproach: Replace fixed display-note height with a 44dp minimum touch zone and natural height; align horizontal avatar rows at the bottom, reserve the editing panel height only while the composer is open, retain matching name/rank baselines.
preserveBehaviors: Both screens retain avatars at 56dp, profile tap navigation, readable max-five-line notes, current user note editing, ranks and existing theme colors.
No changes to auth/session, source of Notes, privacy checks, note expiry, unread counts or rendering cache.
Keep first-view genuine AdMob placements, media feed, dashboard tab navigation and Android installed binary unchanged.
Current staging/production channels are not modified by the source PR.
acceptanceChecks: Engineering Accountability V2 scope gate and mandatory appwide compact gate pass.
Dynamic-height source test verifies empty one-line notes no longer reserve a five-line slot and all avatars remain aligned.
Wall media density test and Connect geometry test pass with intact ad surfaces, tap targets and editing.
PR CI TypeScript passes; perform staged Android Hermes OTA via separately verified exact source and channel, then verify runtime/update receipt.
Physical device verification skipped only at owner's request, not represented as successful.
